legacy.igsh-449.description: OTP, a second pending device and trusted SSH access to every saved host. Sign in on the new device; on the approving phone compare **Approve this device?** and fingerprint, tap **Approve**, then connect from the new device.

legacy.igsh-429.description: a queued real app crash plus account-service receipt access. On a disposable debug install crash, relaunch, complete **Sign in**, and verify the stable report id server-side. Check startup/sign-in drain, including dismissed reports; the console never crashes the app.

legacy.igsh-422.description: first-screen entry is automated. Sync needs OTP, account servers and host-sync capability. Complete **Sign in**, inspect **Session list actions → Hosts** and compare another device; offline hosts do not prove sync.

legacy.igsh-432.description: an agent transcript with multiple new assistant messages after a recorded read position. Read a session, leave, generate replies on the host, check Inbox's count (`<n> unread messages`), reopen and check it clears. The console is not an agent.

legacy.igsh-434.description: Deepgram credential, microphone permission, controlled speech/silence and network/audio evidence. Reader **Session actions → More → Dictation API key**, **API key → Save and dictate**, then **Start dictation / Stop dictation**. Verify transcript and silence gating; short pre-roll/hangover is intentional. IGSH-2286: on a phone with no key, sign in and the Dictation API key field reads Replacement API key with nothing typed; signed out, a hand-typed key still dictates.

legacy.igsh-423.description: saving needs OTP and a pulled account layout. **Session list actions → Settings → Show Frequent split**, Back, check **Frequent**; repeat off and compare another device. Not dispatchable in CI.

legacy.igsh-415.description: account-mapped sessions with input in 24 h, or three watch visits of at least 10 s in 6 h. Send input, return to **Frequent**, compare ordering; check watch-only fallback and **Settings → Newest sessions at bottom** separately.

legacy.igsh-426.description: prefix checks Sign in's exact version only. No credential blocks local-screen layout inspection; navigation/bounds proof is unimplemented. Inspect the label on Inbox, reader, shell, Hosts, editor and Settings; tap for **Update**. Workspaces need OTP. Sign in's label is bottom-centred, not beside three dots.

legacy.igsh-424.description: a supported agent (Claude) transcript on the SSH host, including tables/nested lists and model/effort state. Open from Inbox, scroll the complete transcript, inspect tables horizontally and top-bar subtitle; no **Conversation** header/status row. **Session actions → Session history** opens alternate-screen history. Console output proves none of this.

legacy.igsh-418.description: a real bubble plus swipe/long-press input, beyond the tap-only driver. Swipe right or long-press → **Reply**; inspect **Reply to …**, **Cancel reply**, and send a quoted reply.

legacy.igsh-425.description: multi-touch and long/wide tmux output, no extra credential. **Open live terminal**, pinch (8–28 sp, retained on reopen), pan, swipe down or **Open shell history**, then **Jump to live** / **Back to the live view**. Terminal.md proves attachment only.

legacy.igsh-414.description: matching/close are automated; no credential blocks layout proof, but keyboard-visible bounds inspection is unimplemented. Inbox **Search sessions**, type in **Search all sessions**, inspect results below the box and above the keyboard before closing.

legacy.igsh-413.description: no credential blocks comparing signed-out **Sign in to sync** in Inbox **Session list actions** and reader **Session actions**; that comparison is unimplemented. OTP is needed for **Sync: signed in — sign out** and synced splits. Compare both menus, then complete sign-in manually.

chat.identity.description: Each canonical phone message appears once and keeps its reply across transcript catchup, Fresh start and reconnect.

dictation.cancel.description: Cancel dictation drops the in-progress recording and restores the composer without that transcript or a send.
